markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (89%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Simulated frozen section with JPEG degradation is flagged unreliable, cannot exclude InSitu, and blocks stain orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 89%, InSitu 8%, Normal 3%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%) [F1] | Favors Benign; invasive risk 0% |
| Conformal set | {Benign, InSitu} (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged; AUROC 70%), 100% OOD, JPEG 3 [F6] | Suspect input; out of distribution |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (3 InSitu, 1 Normal, 1 Invasive) [F5] | No neighbors match Benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 5, 6, 10) · context · Above-typical score (1.38); descriptive context only [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.23) reduces invasive risk (-0.73) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (1.57, caption-inconsistent) reduces risk (-0.60) [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Score 0.92 (-0.22), failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001, 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); normal-lobules and mitoses concepts (0/20 AI check) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severe JPEG degradation (level 3) on this simulated frozen section masks in situ disease (3/5 neighbors are InSitu).
- Diagnostic atypia lies deeper than this section plane, requiring the drafted deeper levels and recut H&E.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 0, 9**: Check highest-risk tiles (13%, 12%, 6%) for in situ atypia and drafted deeper levels.
2. **Regions 6, 5, 1, 2, 11**: Verify duct-confined cells (region 6), tubules, and dense lymphocytes on a recut H&E.
3. **Region 8**: Inspect inferior and medial margins (87% probability each); margin call is deferred to permanents [F7].
